name: Agent
description: Spawns a subagent with its own context window to handle a task. See Agent tool behavior

name: AskUserQuestion
description: Asks multiple-choice questions to gather requirements or clarify ambiguity

name: Bash
description: Executes shell commands in your environment. See Bash tool behavior

name: CronCreate
description: Schedules a recurring or one-shot prompt within the current session. Tasks are session-scoped and restored on --resume or --continue if unexpired. See scheduled tasks

name: CronDelete
description: Cancels a scheduled task by ID

name: CronList
description: Lists all scheduled tasks in the session

name: Edit
description: Makes targeted edits to specific files. See Edit tool behavior

name: EnterPlanMode
description: Switches to plan mode to design an approach before coding

name: EnterWorktree
description: Creates an isolated git worktree and switches into it. Pass a path to switch into an existing worktree of the current repository instead of creating a new one. From within a worktree session, or from

name: Glob
description: Finds files based on pattern matching. See Glob tool behavior

name: Grep
description: Searches for patterns in file contents. See Grep tool behavior

name: LSP
description: Code intelligence via language servers: jump to definitions, find references, report type errors and warnings. See LSP tool behavior

name: Monitor
description: Runs a command in the background and feeds each output line back to Claude, so it can react to log entries, file changes, or polled status mid-conversation. See Monitor tool

name: NotebookEdit
description: Modifies Jupyter notebook cells. See NotebookEdit tool behavior

name: PowerShell
description: Executes PowerShell commands natively. See PowerShell tool for availability

name: PushNotification
description: Sends a desktop notification, and a phone push when Remote Control is connected, so a long-running task or scheduled task can reach you when you step away. Push delivery runs through Anthropic-hosted

name: Read
description: Reads the contents of files. See Read tool behavior

name: RemoteTrigger
description: Creates, updates, runs, and lists Routines on claude.ai. Backs the /schedule command. Routines live on claude.ai and require a Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise plan, so this tool is not accessible from A

name: SendMessage
description: Sends a message to an agent team teammate, or resumes a subagent by its agent ID. Stopped subagents auto-resume in the background. Only available when CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is set

name: Skill
description: Executes a skill within the main conversation

name: TaskCreate
description: Creates a new task in the task list

name: TaskGet
description: Retrieves full details for a specific task

name: TaskList
description: Lists all tasks with their current status

name: TaskStop
description: Kills a running background task by ID

name: TaskUpdate
description: Updates task status, dependencies, details, or deletes tasks

name: TeamCreate
description: Creates an agent team with multiple teammates. Only available when CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is set

name: TeamDelete
description: Disbands an agent team and cleans up teammate processes. Only available when CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 is set

name: ToolSearch
description: Searches for and loads deferred tools when tool search is enabled

name: WebFetch
description: Fetches content from a specified URL. See WebFetch tool behavior

name: WebSearch
description: Performs web searches. See WebSearch tool behavior

name: Workflow
description: Runs a dynamic workflow: a script that orchestrates many subagents in the background and returns one consolidated result

name: Write
description: Creates or overwrites files. See Write tool behavior

name: WebSearch
description: WebSearch
